contract.model_visible: Only policy.input is inference-visible; action and weight are training labels; NEVER include evaluator-only challenge in training.
contract.actions: Original legal host MOVE, PAINT_A, PAINT_B, ERASE, STOP; no invented actions.
contract.intervention: New observable warning invalidates previously acquired physical calibration, even if the previously observed cell had been safely erased and the model has already begun moving to the objective.
contract.paired_heldout: Four causally matched pairs per world differ only in hidden law after second alert, with identical inputs before physical re-probe, and different correct protected-goal paint actions afterward.
contract.negatives: Second alert with no drift still requires fresh probe; absence of warning must not induce one; stale-warning control would move toward the objective instead of the safe probe.
contract.grouping: World geometry/source seed retained per split; v52 uses v46 candidate indices 500+, distinct from v44-v51; consumers MUST group cross-version identities by geometry_sha256 and source_seed.
contract.dedup: Exact repeated TRAIN observations zero-weighted; all actions remain for host replay and counterfactual evaluation.

limitations: Synthetic graph host, NOT native CyberSand; SURFACE_ALERT and protected-target semantics hypothetical.
Synthetic event after departure from the safe site is externally injected, not generated by CyberSand gameplay.
A small symbolic per-surface timestamped physical-receipt controller can still solve this benchmark; measure neural HELDOUT instead of claiming learned capability.
Host-executed prelude/survey remains scripted; no target SLM training, inference latency/RSS, native trial or immutable Actions artifact.
